description: Three 100-transaction release runs per load, 20ms one-way loopback delay, four validators sharing host/storage; sync_all retained. Wall-clock service components summed across validators, excluding startup and socket reads. Not a decomposition of client finality. Host not isolated from other development activity.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; no batching; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.
